positions.title: Head of Data Science and AI
positions.description:
Built the company’s AI & data function from zero: designed the end-to-end ML platform, productionised recommendation models, and stood up a modern analytics stack on Databricks.

Designed the core Data Model used by the App, Analytics and ML. 

Lead & mentor a cross-functional team of three ML / data engineers; introduced agile MLOps internal processes. 

Partner to C-suite & Product: shape roadmap, design the AI powered features and define success metrics.

Stack highlights: Databricks · MLFlow · Python ·  Postgres · GitHub Actions.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
In charge of improving and tuning the models that power Gini's  automatic document classification and information extraction engines. I improved the document classifier by  defining standard training / testing/ validation procedures and extending the feature set.   In addition to this, I wrote my M.Sc. dissertation on the applicability of  continuous word vector representation, (i.e. word features) on German language datasets in particular in the context of document classification. 

Tools and Techniques: Support Vector Machines, Scala, Java, ElasticSearch, (i)Python / Scipy.

company.name: Plato
company.tagline: Wir bauen die Zukunft des Großhandels.
company.description:
Plato (DM Technologies GmbH) ist die ganzheitliche Wachstumsplattform für den Großhandel. Wir erhöhen Umsätze durch KI-Analysen wie Up- & Cross-Selling und senken Kosten durch Prozessautomatisierungen verbunden mit tiefer ERP-Integration.

Bei Plato kommen wir selbst aus dem Großhandel, denken wie Familienunternehmer und entwickeln ein Produkt Hand in Hand mit unseren Kunden, um den B2B-Handel für die nächste Generation stark aufzustellen.
